login.title: Sign in to Relayo
login.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.
login.failed: Could not sign in. Try again later.

inbox.selectTicket: Select a ticket to see the conversation
inbox.title: Chats
inbox.soundOn: Turn on sound for new messages

common.comingSoonHelp: This section will appear in one of the next releases.

ticket.replyPlaceholder: Write a message… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
ticket.closedHelp: This ticket is closed. A new message from the client will open a new ticket.
ticket.unverifiedChat: This chat was started by a visitor whose clientId is not verified. Do not share personal data without additional checks.
ticket.notePlaceholder: Internal note… Only staff will see it (Enter to save, Shift+Enter for a new line)
ticket.subject: Subject

client.unverifiedHelp: The site passed clientId directly. Anyone could have set it.

alias.title: Alias for clients
alias.help: Clients see this name instead of your full name. You need it to reply.
alias.label: Alias

settings.saveFailed: Could not save. Try again later.

sites.name: Name
sites.codeHelp: The product code the site passes to the widget. Cannot be changed later.
sites.codeInvalid: Lowercase letters, digits, "-" and "_" only, up to 64 characters
sites.domainsHelp: One per line, e.g. https://example.com. The widget works only on these domains.
sites.keysHelp: The site backend signs client tokens with a key. Keep two active keys while rotating, then revoke the old one.
sites.revokeConfirm: Tokens signed with this key will stop working. Revoke?
sites.secretWarning: Copy the secret now and pass it to the site developers. It will not be shown again.
sites.cacheNote: Changes reach the public service within about a minute.

widgets.name: Channel name
widgets.directWarning: Anyone can call Relayo.setClientId() with someone else’s id. Such visitors see only their own messages, and operators see a “clientId not verified” warning. Use signed tokens when the site can issue them.
widgets.title: Header text
widgets.embedHelp: Paste this line before the closing </body> tag on every page of the site and its mirrors. It loads the published widget file, so the line never changes when you publish new versions.
widgets.embedTokenHint: After the user signs in, get a signed token from your backend and call Relayo.identify(token).
widgets.embedDirectHint: After the user signs in, call Relayo.setProduct(code) and Relayo.setClientId(id).
widgets.telegramHelp: The widget shows a Telegram button next to the chat button. The conversation continues in the same chat.
widgets.siteFixed: A widget cannot be moved to another site.
widgets.modeTokenHelp: The site backend signs a token for each signed-in user: Relayo.identify(token).
widgets.noBots: No bots yet. Add one in Channels → Add channel → Telegram bot.
widgets.embedReady: Relayo.* methods become available when the widget has loaded. If the page calls them right away, wait for the event:
widgets.embedOpenHint: Your own buttons can open the chat or a messenger: Relayo.open(), Relayo.open('tg'), Relayo.open('whatsapp').
widgets.publishNote: Saved changes reach websites after you publish the widget (see Publication below).
widgets.rolledBack: Rolled back and published as v{{version}}
widgets.notPublished: Not published yet: websites will not show the widget until you publish it.
widgets.unpublishedChanges: There are saved changes that are not on websites yet. Websites use v{{version}}.
widgets.upToDate: Websites use the latest version v{{version}} (published {{date}}).
widgets.storageOff: File storage (S3) is not configured, so the widget is embedded directly and takes its settings from the server.
widgets.rollbackConfirm: Return the widget settings to v{{version}} and publish them?
widgets.publishFirst: Publish the widget to get the embed code.
widgets.deleteHelp: Websites stop showing it. Conversations stay in tickets.
widgets.caption: Caption text
widgets.captionHelp: Shown under the message field, e.g. a note about the privacy policy.
widgets.allowAttachmentsHelp: Visitors can attach files with the button or by dragging them into the chat. Size and types are limited on the server.
widgets.kbSendButton: Show the send button in the knowledge base
widgets.replyOffline: Allow replies when the client is offline
widgets.closeOwnOnly: Agents can close only their own chats
widgets.buttonDelayHelp: How many seconds after the page opens the button appears.
widgets.iconUploaded: Image uploaded. Publish the widget to show it on websites.
widgets.iconTooBig: The image must be up to 512×512 pixels
widgets.iconLimit: Maximum image size is 512×512 pixels and 512 KB: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP.
widgets.iconAfterCreate: Save the widget first, then upload an image.
widgets.operatorNameHelp: Visitors see this name instead of agent aliases. Empty — aliases.
widgets.greetingEveryInit: Send the greeting every time the chat starts
widgets.noWhatsApp: No numbers yet. Add one in Channels → Add channel → WhatsApp.

users.blockHelp: A blocked user is signed out everywhere and cannot sign in.
users.passwordSessionsNote: All sessions of this user will be signed out.
users.adNote: Users of the Active Directory folder are imported and blocked automatically:
users.blockedInAdHelp: Blocked by sync: the user left the AD folder or was disabled in AD. Unblocked automatically when back.
users.fromAd: Comes from Active Directory and is updated on every sync.

telegram.name: Channel name
telegram.siteHelp: People who message the bot directly, not from a widget, become clients of this site.
telegram.tokenHelp: Create a bot with @BotFather in Telegram and paste the token it gives you. The token is stored encrypted and is never shown again.
telegram.tokenReplaceHelp: Leave empty to keep the current token.
telegram.intro: Connect a bot, then choose it in the widget settings: the widget will show a “Continue in Telegram” button.
telegram.nameHelp: Optional: the bot name from Telegram is used if empty.
telegram.enabledHelp: A disabled bot does not receive or send messages, and widgets hide the Telegram button.
telegram.widgetsHelp: Choose the bot in a widget’s settings to show the “Continue in Telegram” button.
telegram.deleteHelp: Widgets lose the Telegram button. Conversations stay in tickets, but replies no longer reach Telegram.

whatsapp.name: Channel name
whatsapp.phoneHelp: The WhatsApp number with the country code. The widget’s WhatsApp button opens a chat with it.
whatsapp.phoneInvalid: Enter the number with the country code, for example +7 900 123-45-67
whatsapp.siteHelp: People who write to this number become clients of this site.
whatsapp.enabledHelp: Widgets hide the WhatsApp button of a disabled channel.
whatsapp.intro: Connect a WhatsApp number by scanning a QR code: clients’ messages arrive in Relayo and agents reply from here. Or use “Link only”: the widget just opens a chat with the number in WhatsApp.
whatsapp.widgetsHelp: Choose the number in a widget’s items to show the WhatsApp button.
whatsapp.deleteHelp: Widgets lose the WhatsApp button after they are published.
whatsapp.modeGatewayHelp: Messages to this number arrive in Relayo. The widget button continues the visitor’s chat in WhatsApp.
whatsapp.modeLinkOnlyHelp: The widget opens a chat with this number in WhatsApp. Messages stay in the WhatsApp app and do not reach Relayo.
whatsapp.saveToConnect: Save the channel to show the QR code.
whatsapp.phoneFromWhatsApp: Taken from WhatsApp when the number is connected.
whatsapp.scanSteps: On the phone with this number open WhatsApp → Settings → Linked devices → Link a device, and scan this code.
whatsapp.qrValidUntil: Valid until: {{time}}. The code refreshes by itself.
whatsapp.qrTimeout: The QR code was not scanned in time.
whatsapp.loggedOut: The number was logged out on the phone. Scan a new QR code to connect it again.
whatsapp.notConnectedHelp: The number is not connected yet.
whatsapp.gatewayNotConfigured: The WhatsApp gateway is not configured on the server (WHATSAPP_GATEWAY_URL). Only “Link only” is available.
whatsapp.gatewayUnavailable: The WhatsApp gateway is not responding. Check that it is running.
whatsapp.disconnectHelp: Relayo is removed from the phone’s linked devices and stops receiving messages. You can connect again with a new QR code.

channels.name: Name
channels.needSite: Channels belong to a site. Create a site first:

ldap.enabledHelp: Imported users sign in with their AD login (CN) and password; scheduled sync runs.
ldap.bindDnHelp: Read-only account used to read the users folder.
ldap.passwordKeep: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.
ldap.securityHelp: Without encryption passwords would travel in plain text, so it is not offered.
ldap.verifyOffWarning: Only for a test AD with a self-signed certificate.
ldap.usersDnHelp: Users of this folder are imported, without subfolders. Relayo signs them in as CN=<login>,<folder>.
ldap.guidAttributeHelp: Users are matched by it, so renaming in AD keeps the history.
ldap.loginAttributeHelp: Used only to sign in, never shown to clients.
ldap.defaultRoleHelp: Role of newly imported users. You can change it per agent later.
ldap.syncIntervalHelp: 0 — only with the “Import users” button. Users who left the folder are blocked, history is kept.
ldap.savedNotConnected: Saved, but could not connect. See the status below.
ldap.optionalAttribute: Optional: taken from AD on every sync. Leave empty to skip.

rules.empty: No rules yet. Create the first one.
rules.dragHint: Drag to change the order: rules apply from top to bottom
rules.engineNote: Rules apply from top to bottom on every event. Actions of rules do not trigger other rules. Auto-replies: at most 3 per ticket per hour. The “Message out of office hours” event will work once office hours are set up.
rules.name: Name
rules.messageHelp: This message is sent when the conditions are met. Variables: {client.name}, {operator.alias}, {ticket.number}.

agents.name: Name
agents.deleteGroupConfirm: Delete the group? {{count}} agent(s) will leave it.
agents.loginHelp: Used to sign in. For Active Directory users it is the CN.
agents.emailHelp: Work email, visible only to staff.
agents.passwordHelp: For signing in to Relayo. At least 10 characters.
agents.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the current password. A new password signs the agent out everywhere.
agents.passwordAd: The password is checked by Active Directory.
agents.nameHelp: Full name, visible only to staff. Clients see the alias.
agents.phoneHelp: Work phone with extension, or mobile.
agents.noGroupsHint: Create groups on the Agents page: “Create group”.
agents.deleteConfirm: Delete this agent? Agents with conversation history can only be blocked.
agents.deleteAd: Remove the user from the Active Directory folder: sync will block them.
